- **Why it’s cool**: It’s used in **medicine** (anti-inflammatory), **cosmetics** (exfoliating), and even **cheese-making** (helps curdle milk).  
- **Bonus fact**: Pineapples are **“multiple fruits”**—they’re formed from the fusion of **200+ tiny flowers** (called **syconiums**) into one juicy mass. The core? The **center of the original flower**. So, when you eat a pineapple, you’re technically eating a **flower’s dream come true**. 🌸
